title: Step
description: One reconcile unit: move one dimension of observed state toward desired and prove the delta was consumed. The definition is data; the engine (control plane) interprets it and the executor (execution plane) performs the single `execute` action. The executor never decides what runs next.

layer.description: Dependency layer, serial between layers. Orthogonal to blast-radius tiers inside a layer.

reversible.description: true: undone by re-pointing or rollout undo. false: needs a proven backup; refused without one.

backup_precondition.description: Assertion id (e.g. etcd-snapshot-fresh) that must hold before an irreversible step may execute.

batch.description: 1 for a canary, then a count or a percentage

already_done.description: If this holds before execute, the step is converged and skipped (idempotent re-entry).

engine.description: The real tool class this action belongs to.

signoff.description: Under manual policy: an operator signature is required before execute.

probe.description: Registered probe name, e.g. etcd.max_raft_lag. Baseline-relative probes end in _delta or _new_count and compare baseline with after.

expected.description: Literal, or $target / $target_ami resolved from the snapshot meta.
